 Key points
 In a Post Office savings account (4%), ₹6,908 earns about ₹276 in a year. 
 A one-year time deposit (6.9%) pays ₹489 interest on ₹6,900. 
 Left untouched for 5 years, NSC (7.7%) pays the most — ₹6,900 becomes ₹9,998. 
 If your daughter has a Sukanya Samriddhi account, it pays the highest rate — 8.2%. 
 Advertisement
 New Delhi, 24 October: Lakhs of central government employees got their Diwali bonus this month — ₹6,908 for most, ₹13,816 for postal and ESIC staff, and up to ₹17,951 in the Railways. If you are not spending it straight away, one question is left: where should it go so it keeps growing after Diwali?
 A Post Office savings account pays 4%, so ₹6,908 earns about ₹276 in a year. Put into the Post Office’s other government-backed schemes, the same money can earn far more. Here is the full working at the rates the Finance Ministry has set for October–December 2026.
 What ₹6,908 becomes
 Where Rate For how long What you get 
 Post Office savings account 4.0% 1 year about ₹276 interest 
 Time deposit (1 year) 6.9% 1 year ₹489 interest on ₹6,900 — ₹7,389 in all 
 Time deposit (5 years) 7.5% 5 years ₹532 interest every year — ₹2,660 over 5 years 
 NSC 7.7% 5 years ₹6,900 grows to ₹9,998 
 Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) 7.5% 115 months ₹6,900 grows to ₹13,800 
 Time deposits, NSC and KVP go in multiples of ₹100, so the working uses ₹6,900. All figures come from our calculators.
 Need the money within a year? A time deposit
 If you are keeping it for a cost next year — a festival, fees, a repair — a one-year time deposit is the simplest choice. ₹6,900 earns ₹489 by the year’s end, about 1.8 times what the savings account pays.
 Won’t touch it for 5 years? NSC leads
 The five-year time deposit also pays 7.5%, but its interest is paid out every year — ₹532 a year, ₹2,660 over five years. NSC’s 7.7% is added back every year and the whole amount is paid at the end of 5 years. So if you really will not touch the money, NSC pays more: ₹3,098 interest on ₹6,900, ₹9,998 in all.
 Want to double it? Kisan Vikas Patra
 A KVP doubles the deposit in 115 months — 9 years and 7 months. A ₹6,900 KVP comes back as ₹13,800.
 Does your daughter have a Sukanya account?
 If your daughter has a Sukanya Samriddhi account, putting the bonus there earns the highest rate — 8.2%. Deposits run from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year for 15 years, and the account matures 21 years after it is opened. See what yours becomes on the Sukanya calculator .
 Turn the bonus into a habit
 The bonus comes once a year; a savings habit comes every month. A ₹500-a-month Post Office RD (6.7%) becomes ₹35,683 in 5 years — ₹30,000 deposited, ₹5,683 interest. Try your own instalment on the RD calculator .
 Keep in mind
 These are the October–December 2026 rates. The government sets them every quarter, and they have not changed since 1 January 2024. See all current rates here .
 With a ₹13,816 or ₹17,951 bonus, read the table at roughly two or two and a half times — get the exact amounts on the Post Office savings calculator and the NSC calculator .
 Source: Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) O.M.s of 29 December 2023 (rate table) and 30 September 2026 (rates unchanged for October–December 2026); Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme rules, 2019; maturity figures from indianpaycalculator.in calculators.

 Critical AdSense behaviour: adsbygoogle.push({}) does NOT bind to
 a specific . It says "process the next unbound in DOM
 order." So if you push N times, AdSense binds the first N 
 slots it finds.
 Live investigation (2026-05-29) showed the right sidebar still
 loading late on indianpaycalculator.in. DOM order of :
 1. LEFT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-left)
 2-5. Display banners (4× AdBanner inside page content)
 6. RIGHT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-right, after main slot)
 7. Mobile anchor (StickyAnchorAd at body end)
 Previously this script pushed twice (one per sidebar). Those 2
 pushes bound LEFT + Display#1, NOT LEFT + RIGHT. The other 5
 slots only got bound as AdBanner.client:visible islands hydrated
 on scroll — meaning the right sidebar was bound 6th, after the
 user scrolled past every in-page banner. That's the "right side
 opens very late" complaint.
 Fix: push once per SSR'd ad slot. AdSense binds them all in DOM
 order at body parse end — no React hydration wait, no scroll-to-
 view wait. Subsequent React useEffect pushes (from AdUnit /
 StickyAnchorAd) become no-ops since the AdUnit effect skips when
 data-adsbygoogle-status is already set. --> component was removed 2026-05-29 to eliminate the
